role: Bit-exact Python re-implementations of the deterministic random sources used by Emuqu unit tests at e028039 (SplitMix64, Swift Double.random(in: ClosedRange, using:) with Lemire next(upperBound:), the classifier tests' LCG deterministicOffset) so test_ports.py can regenerate their fixtures.

units.does: SplitMix64 constructor: stores seed masked to 64 bits as state.
Advances state by 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15 and returns the SplitMix64-mixed 64-bit output.
Lemire unbiased bounded integer in [0, upper): multiplies a 64-bit draw by upper, rejects while low word < (2^64-upper) % upper, returns the high word (Swift RandomNumberGenerator.next(upperBound:)).

branches.effect: computes threshold t and redraws while low < t; otherwise returns high immediately

units.does: Swift Double.random(in: lo...hi): draws r in [0, 2^53] inclusive; r == 2^53 returns hi exactly, else returns lo + (hi-lo) * r * ulp/2.
